description: Read-only status lookup for a single trade created by place_trade. Pass the place_trade actionId returned by the approval request, or the deterministic singleTradeBotId/managerBotId single-trade-<actionId>. The tool verifies the action belongs to the signed-in user, then returns the approval state, one-shot Bot Manager status, Lambda request id, broker order result when available, or execution error details.
name: get_single_trade_status
title: Check single-trade execution status
